answers.description: Rated 4.9 on Google by over 300 patients, we have been the number one family dentist in Harrogate since 1998. Two surgeries, 0% finance on treatment over £500, open 7 days a week from 8am to 8pm, award-winning hygienists and a 10 year guarantee on crowns.

headline: Your family
dentist, open
every day
hero.subhead: Dental care in Harrogate, built around your family. Open every day of the week for your visit.

items.description: Two surgeries in Harrogate, ready to welcome you and your family for every visit.
We open seven days a week, from 8am to 8pm, so you can book when it suits you.
We offer 0% finance on treatment over £500, making larger dental work easier to plan for.
Our hygienists bring care and attention to every visit, helping you look after your smile.

services.heading: We care for your family's smiles, every day of the week.

about.statement: We set up Oakfield to give Harrogate families a dentist they can see any day of the week.

items.question: Are you open every day of the week?
items.answer: Yes, we open seven days a week, from 8am to 8pm, so you can book a visit when it suits you.

items.question: Do you offer payment plans for treatment?
items.answer: We offer 0% finance on treatment over £500, making larger dental work easier to plan for.

items.question: How many surgeries do you have?
items.answer: We have two surgeries, both ready for your check-up, treatment or hygiene visit.

items.question: Do you offer hygienist appointments?
items.answer: Our hygienists bring care and attention to every visit, helping you look after your smile.

items.question: How do I book an appointment?
items.answer: Contact our practice by phone or online to ask about an appointment that suits you.
